mechanism.claim: When quote turnover in a completed high-variation BTC block is unusually concentrated into a small subset of five-minute auctions and the quote-weighted return agrees with total displacement, discrete sponsored information arrival is dominating ambient churn. Follow the common direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of quote-turnover-weighted five-minute return and completed eight-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTCCR uses the Herfindahl concentration of all 96 five-minute quote-turnover shares. HVDVBR selected one maximum-volume bar; HVTAB used execution-count backloading; CATACF used cross-asset trade-count HHI; late-volume candidates used a fixed terminal share. HVTCCR uses no flow classification, ticket size, cross-assets, fitted outcomes, prior event, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: causal upper-tail variation plus concentrated turnover isolates episodic sponsored price discovery during volatile auctions
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC turnover-concentration onsets with eight-hour reservation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 96 exact coherent BTCUSDT perpetual five-minute aggregates from 480 unique one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.bar_quote_turnover: sum quote_asset_volume across each exact five-minute group, finite nonnegative; total strict positive
features.concentration_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.block_return: log(last close/first open), strict nonzero and same sign as quote_weighted_return
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no HHI, rank, direction confirmation, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
